topic: Updating API payloads for campaign data
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on updating the payload structure for API calls related to campaign data. Specifically, a serialized array of periods (with day numbering starting from Monday) was added to the `/api/campaigns/target/total-traffic` endpoint payload.

It was noted that this period serialization should also be applied to reports payloads. Someone agreed to begin with the Campaign Planner, as it contains a new parameter, and will subsequently add the necessary period data structure to the general reports.
decisions: Add serialized period array to `/api/campaigns/target/total-traffic` payload
Apply period serialization logic to report payloads
action_items: [p1] to add period data structure to reports
Start with Campaign Planner updates first
